在线学习Online Learning with
梯度变化区间后悔Gradient-Variation Interval Regret

Yan-Feng Xie, Shuche Wang, Peng Zhao and Zhi-Hua Zhou Yan-Feng Xie, Peng Zhao and Zhi-Hua Zhou are with State Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology and the School of Artificial Intelligence, Nanjing University, Nanjing 210023, China. (e-mail: xieyf@lamda.nju.edu.cn; zhaop@lamda.nju.edu.cn; zhouzh@lamda.nju.edu.cn). Shuche Wang is with Institute of Operations Research and Analytics, National University of Singapore, Singapore 117602 (e-mail: shuche.wang@u.nus.edu).
摘要Abstract

本文使用以下指标研究非平稳在线学习This paper investigates non-stationary online learning using the metric of间隔遗憾interval regret，这需要在线算法在每个时间间隔内都表现良好。 我们提出了第一个在线学习算法，该算法实现了区间后悔界限缩放, which requires an online algorithm to perform well over every time interval. We propose the first online learning algorithm that achieves an interval regret bound scaling with梯度变化gradient variation，在线函数梯度累积变化的基本度量，与各种问题相关量相关，并且与随机优化和其他问题密切相关。 我们的方法采用简单高效的两层在线集成结构，实现了强有力的理论保证。具体来说，它具有遗憾界限，可以同时适应各种与问题相关的量，同时在最坏的情况下保持极小极大最优率。 此外，认识到超参数调整的挑战，我们引入了一种与 Lipschitz 和平滑度无关的变体，可以自动适应这些潜在的未知常数。这主要得益于一部小说, a fundamental measure of the cumulative change in online function gradients, which relates to various problem-dependent quantities and is closely connected to stochastic optimization and other problems. Our method employs a simple and efficient two-layer online ensemble structure that achieves strong theoretical guarantees. Specifically, it enjoys a regret bound that simultaneously adapts to various problem-dependent quantities while also preserving the minimax-optimal rate in the worst case. Moreover, recognizing the challenge of hyperparameter tuning, we introduce a Lipschitz- and smoothness-agnostic variant that automatically adapts to these potentially unknown constants. This is primarily enabled by a novelLipschitz 自适应元算法Lipschitz-adaptive meta algorithm，这可能具有独立利益。 除了区间遗憾之外，我们的方法还产生了更广泛的影响：它为区间动态遗憾提供了通用的界限，这是一种更强的衡量标准，可以与任何区间内不断变化的比较器竞争，并为随机扩展对抗性优化提供第一个分段表征。理论研究结果通过实验得到验证。, which may be of independent interest. Beyond interval regret, our method also yields broader implications: it provides versatile bounds for interval dynamic regret, a stronger measure that competes with changing comparators over any interval, and yields the first piecewise characterization for stochastic extended adversarial optimization. Theoretical findings are validated by experiments.

I 简介Introduction

本文研究了在线凸优化（OCO）框架内的在线学习This paper investigates online learning within the framework of online convex optimization (OCO)[1, 2]，学习者和环境之间顺序决策的通用范例。在 OCO 框架下，学习者需要提供一个决策, a general paradigm for sequential decision-making between a learner and the environments. Under the OCO framework, the learner is required to provide a decision𝐱t∈𝒳\mathbf{x}_{t}\in\mathcal{X}来自凸决策集from a convex decision set𝒳\mathcal{X}每轮迭代iteratively at each roundt∈[T]t\in[T]。随后，环境揭示了凸损失函数. Subsequently, the environments reveal a convex loss functionft:𝒳↦ℝf_{t}:\mathcal{X}\mapsto\mathbb{R}，学习者遭受损失, and the learner incurs the lossft​(𝐱t)f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})。一个经典的目标是最大限度地减少遗憾，它衡量事后针对单个最佳固定决策的累积损失：. A classic objective is to minimize the regret, which measures the cumulative loss against the single best fixed decision in hindsight:

RegT=∑t=1Tft​(𝐱t)−min𝐱∈𝒳​∑t=1Tft​(𝐱).\displaystyle\textsc{Reg}_{T}=\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-\min_{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf{x}). (1)

这个遗憾将性能与固定比较器进行了基准测试This regret benchmarks the performance against a fixed comparator𝐱⋆∈arg​min𝐱∈𝒳​∑t=1Tft​(𝐱)\mathbf{x}_{\star}\in\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf{x})事后诸葛亮，又称静悔。然而，在最佳决策可能随时间变化的非平稳环境中，静态后悔就变得不充分。为了解决这个限制，已经提出了更稳健的性能测量。本文重点讨论in hindsight, also known as the static regret. However, static regret becomes an inadequate measure in non-stationary environments where the optimal decision may change over time. To address this limitation, more robust performance measures have been proposed. This paper focuses on间隔遗憾interval regret [3]（也称为(also referred to as适应性后悔adaptive regret在一些文献中in some literature[4, 5, 6]），定义为任何连续时间间隔内的遗憾), which is defined as the regret over any contiguous time interval[r,s]⊆[T][r,s]\subseteq[T]:

I-Reg[r,s]=∑t=rsft​(𝐱t)−min𝐱∈𝒳​∑t=rsft​(𝐱).\displaystyle\textsc{I-Reg}_{[r,s]}=\sum_{t=r}^{s}f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-\min_{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\sum_{t=r}^{s}f_{t}(\mathbf{x}). (2)

从概念上讲，区间后悔通过确保算法在任意区间内针对局部事后最佳决策表现良好，从而提供了更强的性能保证。这种方法更适合不断变化的环境，因为单个最佳决策的假设在较短的局部间隔内比在整个时间范围内更合理。Conceptually, interval regret provides a stronger performance guarantee by ensuring that the algorithm performs well against the local best-in-hindsight decision within an arbitrary interval. This measure is more suitable for changing environments, as the assumption of a single best decision is more plausible over shorter, local intervals than over the entire time horizon.

设计具有区间后悔保证的算法的核心挑战是需要处理固有的非平稳性：要求算法在任何可能的时间间隔内都表现良好，而无需提前知道哪些间隔会很困难。为了解决这个问题，标准方法是利用两层在线集成框架The central challenge in designing algorithms with interval regret guarantees is the need to handle inherent non-stationarity: the algorithms are required to perform well over any possible time interval, without knowing in advance which intervals will be difficult. To address this, a standard approach is to leverage the two-layer online ensemble framework[7]以减轻不确定性。该框架采用元学习器，动态组合来自基础学习器池的预测。每个基础学习器都是 OCO 算法的实例。为了保持计算效率，这一庞大的专家集由一个时间表来管理，该时间表确定在每个时间步运行哪个基础学习器子集。to mitigate the uncertainty. This framework employs a meta learner that dynamically combines the predictions from a pool of base learners. Each base learner is an instantiation of an OCO algorithm. To maintain computational efficiency, this large set of experts is managed by a schedule that determines which subset of base learners to run at each time step.

除了提供强大的性能保证之外，我们的算法还被设计为对初始参数调整具有鲁棒性，这是函数属性可能发生巨大变化的非平稳环境中的常见挑战。为了实现这一目标，我们使用 Lipschitz 和平滑自适应性扩展了算法。这意味着该算法不需要先验了解关键函数参数、全局 Lipschitz 常数In addition to providing strong performance guarantees, our algorithm is also designed to be robust to initial parameter tuning, a common challenge in non-stationary environments where function properties can vary dramatically. To achieve this, we extend the algorithm with Lipschitz and smoothness adaptivity. This means the algorithm does not require prior knowledge of key function parameters, the global Lipschitz constantGG或平滑常数or the smoothness constantLL。相反，它会动态适应这些常量，同时确保可比较的保证，从而增强其实际部署的可用性。. Instead, it adapts to these constants on the fly while ensuring comparable guarantees, enhancing its usability for practical deployment.

现在，我们总结了我们的主要技术贡献，这些贡献解决了优化非平稳在线学习的间隔遗憾的三个关键挑战。We now summarize our main technical contributions, which address three key challenges in optimizing the interval regret for non-stationary online learning.

  • •

    第一个梯度变化区间遗憾。The First Gradient-Variation Interval Regret Bound.我们建立了随梯度变化缩放的第一个区间后悔界限。先前对梯度变化边界的分析通常依赖于利用算法自身稳定性提供的负项来取消推导过程中引入的正项。然而，这种方法与间隔遗憾算法不兼容，因为专家集合的动态管理（激活和停用基础学习器）会产生不稳定性，从而阻止使用此类术语。我们的关键技术见解是通过仔细利用损失函数的平滑性提供的内在负布雷格曼散度项来解决这个问题，这使我们能够实现所需的抵消并建立有利的梯度变化界限。We establish the first interval regret bound that scales with gradient variation. Prior analyses for gradient-variation bounds often rely on leveraging the negative terms provided by the algorithm’s own stability to cancel the positive terms introduced during the derivation. However, this approach is incompatible with interval regret algorithms, as the dynamic management of the expert ensemble (activating and deactivating base learners) creates an instability that prevents the use of such terms. Our key technical insight is to tackle this issue by carefully leveraging the intrinsic negative Bregman divergence terms provided by the smoothness of the loss functions, which allows us to achieve the desired cancellation and establish the favorable gradient-variation bound.

  • •

    由此产生的保证的多功能性。Versatility of the Resulting Guarantee.由此产生的梯度变化界限具有很强的通用性。首先，我们的分析揭示了三种不同类型的保证之间的重要联系，展示了梯度变化边界如何隐含小损失边界和极小最大最优边界，从而获得综合结果。其次，我们证明在相同的配置下，我们的算法的保证可以意味着更强的区间动态遗憾界限，为该度量提供第一个通用的问题相关界限。The resulting gradient-variation bound is highly versatile. First, our analysis reveals the important connections between three different types of guarantees, showing how the gradient-variation bound can imply both the small-loss bound and the minimax-optimal bound, thus achieving a comprehensive result. Second, we demonstrate that under the same configuration, our algorithm’s guarantees can imply stronger interval dynamic regret bounds, providing the first versatile problem-dependent bounds for this measure.

  • •

    元算法设计中的参数自适应。Parameter Adaptivity in Meta Algorithm Design.为了进一步提高算法在非平稳环境中参数调整的鲁棒性，我们将我们的方法扩展为与 Lipschitz 和平滑常数无关。这主要是通过新的 Lipschitz 自适应元算法实现的，该算法是通过引入新颖的学习率设计来实现的。这种 Lipschitz 自适应元算法的新遗憾保证和分析可能具有独立意义。To further improve the algorithm’s robustness to parameter tuning in non-stationary environments, we extend our method to be agnostic to the Lipschitz and smoothness constants. This is primarily enabled by a new Lipschitz-adaptive meta algorithm, which is achieved by introducing a novel learning rate design. The new regret guarantee and analysis for this Lipschitz-adaptive meta algorithm may be of independent interest.

我们进行数值实验以凭经验验证我们算法的有效性。首先，使用合成数据，我们评估算法的 Lipschitz 适应性并进行消融研究，以证明其在标准设置中的稳健性能。其次，我们在现实数据集上构建了一个结合了对抗性和随机性成分的混合优化场景。本实验进一步验证了该算法适应梯度变化的有效性。We conduct numerical experiments to validate the effectiveness of our algorithm empirically. First, using synthetic data, we evaluate the algorithm’s Lipschitz adaptivity and perform an ablation study to demonstrate its robust performance in standard settings. Second, we construct a hybrid optimization scenario on a real-world dataset that combines adversarial and stochastic components. This experiment further validates the algorithm’s effectiveness in adapting to gradient variation.

Ⅱ-BII-B 问题相关的遗憾界限Problem-Dependent Regret Bound

在 OCO 框架中，对于凸损失函数，结果为In the OCO framework, for convex loss functions, the results in[1, 8]建立最小最大静态遗憾界限establish a minimax static regret bound ofΘ​(T)\Theta(\sqrt{T})。问题相关边界通过利用环境的属性提供更精细的分析，而不是关注最坏情况的依赖. Problem-dependent bounds offer a more refined analysis by exploiting the properties of the environments rather than focusing on the worst-case dependence onTT。一个著名的例子是小损失界限，它将遗憾与最佳固定比较器的累积损失联系起来. One well-known example is the small-loss bound, which relates regret to the cumulative loss of the best fixed comparatorFT=min𝐱​∑t=1Tft​(𝐱)F_{T}=\min_{\mathbf{x}}\sum_{t=1}^{T}f_{t}(\mathbf{x}) [9, 10, 35].

另一个重要的与问题相关的量是由下式提出的梯度变化：Another significant problem-dependent quantity is the gradient variation proposed by[11]。自从引入动态遗憾最小化以来，梯度变化自适应性的研究又重新兴起. The study of gradient-variation adaptivity has been revived since its introduction to dynamic regret minimization[36, 7]，它促进了专门的算法设计和新的分析技术，并进一步刺激了各种环境下不断增长的研究, which has promoted dedicated algorithmic designs and new analytical techniques, and has further stimulated a growing line of research in various settings[17, 37, 18, 38, 13, 39, 40]。梯度变化被认为是一个更基本的量，因为基于梯度变化的保证可以意味着小损失保证. Gradient variation is recognized as a more fundamental quantity, as guarantees based on gradient variation can imply small-loss guarantees[7]。梯度变化的重要性也延伸到在线学习：它提供了多人游戏中快速收敛速度的途径. The importance of gradient variation also extends across online learning: it provides a path to fast convergence rates in multi-player games[41, 42]，有助于弥合随机优化和对抗性优化之间的差距，并链接在线和离线加速方法, helps bridge the gap between stochastic and adversarial optimization, and links online and offline accelerated methods[43, 44, 45]。 受这些见解的启发，我们的工作重点关注这个量，并且我们以梯度变化的形式提出了第一个区间遗憾界限，这也可以暗示小损失界限。. Motivated by these insights, our work focuses on this quantity, and we present the first interval regret bound in terms of gradient variation, which can imply the small-loss bound as well.

In non-stationary environments, accurately estimating this value is often infeasible, and a misspecifiedGG可能会降低性能may degrade performance[35, 48, 49]。先前的文献已经探讨了利普希茨在各种环境中的适应性，包括无界域. Prior literature has explored Lipschitz adaptivity in various settings, including unbounded domains[48, 52, 53], and alongside adaptation to function curvature [49, 54, 38, 55]。然而，在理解如何专门针对非平稳环境实现 Lipschitz 适应性方面仍然存在差距。这项工作通过开发一种提供梯度变化保证的 Lipschitz 自适应算法来解决这一差距，从而提高其参数调整的鲁棒性。. Nevertheless, a gap remains in understanding how to achieve Lipschitz adaptivity specifically for non-stationary environments. This work addresses this gap by developing a Lipschitz-adaptive algorithm that provides gradient-variation guarantees, thereby improving its parameter tuning robustness.

Ⅲ-BIII-B 基本思想：两层在线集成框架Basic Idea: Two-Layer Online Ensemble Framework

The non-stationarity in interval regret, defined in Eq. （The non-stationarity in interval regret, defined in Eq. (2），主要是由于算法在哪些时间间隔上可能表现不佳的不确定性。为了应对这一挑战，一个基本的设计原则是构建一个基础学习器集合并将它们适当地组合起来), primarily arises from the uncertainty about which intervals an algorithm may perform poorly on. To tackle this challenge, a fundamental design principle is to construct an ensemble of base learners and combine them appropriately[7]，利用整体来减轻非平稳性。具体来说，算法设计由三个部分组成：基础学习器、元学习器和时间表。每个基础学习器都是专门负责在特定时间间隔内进行预测的专家, leveraging the ensemble to mitigate non-stationarity. Specifically, the algorithmic design consists of three components: base learners, a meta learner, and a schedule. Each base learner is an expert specialized for making predictions over a specific time intervalIi⊆[T]I_{i}\subseteq[T] [4, 3]。然后使用元学习器来汇总决策. A meta learner is then employed to aggregate the decisions𝐱t,i∈𝒳\mathbf{x}_{t,i}\in\mathcal{X}来自每个基础学习者使用在线更新的权重from each base learner using an online-updated weightpt,i∈[0,1]p_{t,i}\in[0,1]。最后，调度通过确定在任何给定时间哪些基础学习器处于活动状态来有效地管理集成。具体来说，时间表被定义为划分时间范围的一组间隔. Finally, the schedule efficiently manages the ensemble by determining which base learners are active at any given time. Concretely, the schedule is defined as a set of intervals that partitions the time horizon[1,T][1,T]，每个间隔指定基础学习器的活跃周期。图。, with each interval specifying the active period of a base learner. 第一项，元遗憾，衡量元学习器在每个子区间跟踪最佳活跃基础学习器的程度。第二项是基础后悔，衡量基础学习者的表现。虽然分析基本遗憾通常很简单，但限制元遗憾通常更具挑战性。这是因为它需要将调度机制和基础学习器的性能联系起来的复杂分析。The first term, the meta regret, measures how well the meta learner tracks the best active base learner in each sub-interval. The second term, the base regret, measures the performance of the base learners. While analyzing the base regret is often straightforward, bounding the meta regret is typically more challenging. This is because it requires a sophisticated analysis connecting both the scheduling mechanism and the performance of the base learners.

IV 我们的方法：梯度变化区间遗憾界Our Approach: Gradient-Variation Interval Regret Bound

在本节中，我们首先介绍所提出的基于两层集成框架的算法，然后提供其关键理论分析。为了表述清楚起见，我们在本节中假设 Lipschitz 常数In this section, we first introduce the proposed algorithm based on the two-layer ensemble framework and then provide its key theoretical analysis. For clarity of presentation, we assume in this section that the Lipschitz constantGG和平滑常数and the smoothness constantLL为学习者所知。are known to the learner.

IV-A 基本组件Basic Components

基于两层集成框架，我们的设计需要三个关键组件来实现区间遗憾界限：基本算法、元算法和调度。我们在下面详细描述这些组件，然后将它们集成到最终的算法中。所有三个组件都被设计为适应环境，通过它们的协调交互，整体算法达到了预期的保证。Based on the two-layer ensemble framework, our design requires three key components to achieve the interval regret bound: a base algorithm, a meta algorithm, and a schedule. We describe these components in detail below and then integrate them into the final algorithm. All three components are designed to be adaptive to the environments, and through their coordinated interaction, the overall algorithm achieves the desired guarantees.

基本算法Base Algorithm

每个基本算法负责特定间隔上的在线学习任务，这使得它可以在不处理整个时间范围的非平稳性的情况下进行预测。直观上，每个基础学习器都可以被视为捕获了环境中一定程度的局部稳定性。对于我们的设计，我们采用乐观在线梯度下降算法Each base algorithm is responsible for the online learning task on a specific interval, which allows it to predict without handling the non-stationarity of the entire time horizon. Intuitively, each base learner can be viewed as capturing a certain level of local stability in the environments. For our design, we adopt the optimistic online gradient descent algorithm[11, 57]，两步更新方法形式化为：, a two-step update method formalized as:

Furthermore, through a white-box reduction, our main result directly implies a nearly optimal guarantee for interval dynamic regret[6, 22]，一个严格更强的绩效衡量标准。这个结果在定理中陈述, a strictly stronger performance measure. 在定理中In Theorem1，我们的算法实现的边界是三种不同类型边界中的最小值，每个边界都匹配最知名的速率：梯度变化边界、小损失边界和最佳最坏情况边界。因此，我们也将其称为“三个世界中最好的”结果。我们现在重点介绍实现这一结果的两个技术联系。首先，我们展示经验梯度变化如何定义（, our algorithm achieves a bound that is the minimum of three different types of bounds, each matching the best-known rates: the gradient-variation bound, the small-loss bound, and the optimal worst-case bound. Consequently, we also refer to it as a “best-of-three-worlds” result. We now highlight two technical connections that enable this result. First, we show how the empirical gradient variation, defined in (9），一个在我们的分析中自然出现的量，意味着小损失界限。关键步骤是通过梯度范数平方和来限制该经验量：), a quantity that naturally arises in our analysis, implies the small-loss bound. The key step is to bound this empirical quantity by a sum of squared gradient norms:

∑t∈I∥∇ft​(𝐱t)−∇ft−1​(𝐱t−1)∥22≤𝒪​(∑t∈I∥∇ft​(𝐱t)∥22).\displaystyle\sum_{t\in I}\lVert\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})-\nabla f_{t-1}(\mathbf{x}_{t-1})\rVert_{2}^{2}\leq\mathcal{O}\Big(\sum_{t\in I}\lVert\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})\rVert_{2}^{2}\Big).

然后，通过应用平滑函数的自边界性质，即Then, by applying the self-bounding property of smooth functions, i.e.,∥∇ft​(𝐱t)∥22≤2​L​ft​(𝐱t)\lVert\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})\rVert_{2}^{2}\leq 2Lf_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t})，并按照标准分析步骤，我们可以得出小损失界限。 其次，我们证明这个小损失界限可以用来收紧最坏情况的界限。关键的见解在于我们的问题相关计划，它使用累积损失来构建一系列几何间隔。这种构造可以避免使用柯西-施瓦茨不等式，从而使我们能够利用几何求和来消除对数因子以获得更严格的最终界限。, and following standard analytical steps, we can derive the small-loss bound. Second, we demonstrate that this small-loss bound can be used to tighten the worst-case bound. The key insight lies in our problem-dependent schedule, which uses cumulative loss to construct a sequence of geometric intervals. This construction can avoid the use of the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, allowing us to instead leverage a geometric summation to eliminate a logarithmic factor for a tighter final bound.

由于我们的问题相关时间表的设计，这仍然是一个技术挑战。该计划的机制基于监控累积损失，This remains a technical challenge due to the design of our problem-dependent schedule. Because the schedule is tied to the cumulative loss, its performance is naturally coupled with the small-loss quantity. We leave this problem as an open question for future research.

This section addresses this challenge by developing a more robust, Lipschitz-adaptive method that provides competitive guarantees没有without先验知识prior knowledge ofGG和andLL。我们的方法是双重的。首先，我们介绍实现这种自适应性的关键组件，一种重新设计的元算法，具有相应的理论保证，这可能是独立的兴趣。当提供 Lipschitz 常数时，我们的元算法可以优雅地恢复之前的结果。其次，我们利用这个新组件构建一个 Lipschitz 自适应算法，以实现所需的梯度变化区间后悔边界。. Our approach is twofold. First, we introduce the key component for achieving this adaptivity, a redesigned meta algorithm with corresponding theoretical guarantees, which may be of independent interest. Our meta algorithm can gracefully recover the previous result when the Lipschitz constant is provided. Second, we leverage this new component to construct a Lipschitz-adaptive algorithm that achieves the desired gradient-variation interval regret bounds.

VI 影响和应用Implications and Applications

为了进一步证明我们提出的方法的多功能性，我们介绍了以下含义和应用。在部分To further demonstrate the versatility of our proposed method, we introduce the following implications and applications. In SectionVI-A，我们证明 GAIR-L 暗示了区间动态遗憾界限，这是对非平稳环境的更强衡量标准。该结果是使用相同的算法配置通过白盒缩减来实现的。在部分, we show that GAIR-L implies the interval dynamic regret bound, a stronger measure for non-stationary environments. This result is achieved using the same algorithm configuration through a white-box reduction. In SectionVI-B，我们研究了随机扩展对抗（SEA）模型，这是一个统一随机和对抗优化的框架。我们证明我们的结果可以直接应用于 SEA 模型，从而在局部区间内产生该模型的第一个分段特征。, we study the Stochastically Extended Adversarial (SEA) model, a framework that unifies stochastic and adversarial optimization. We demonstrate that our result can be directly applied to the SEA model, yielding the first piecewise characterization of this model over local intervals.

六一AVI-A 区间动态后悔界限的含义Implication for Interval Dynamic Regret Bounds

在非平稳在线学习中，两种经典的绩效衡量指标受到了极大的关注。第一个是后悔间隔，在方程中定义。 （In non-stationary online learning, two classical performance measures have received significant attention. The first is the interval regret, defined in Eq. (2），这是这项工作的主要焦点。它是在任意间隔上定义的，并以局部方式捕获非平稳性。二是动态遗憾), which is the primary focus of this work. It is defined over arbitrary intervals and captures non-stationarity in a local manner. The second is the dynamic regret[1, 32, 36, 33]，通常定义为, typically defined as

Such robustness considerations are increasingly important in the broader context of building trustworthy and reliable machine learning in open environments[65, 66].

六-BVI-B 随机扩展对抗模型的应用Application to Stochastically Extended Adversarial Model

随机扩展对抗（SEA）模型提供了一个统一的框架，可以在对抗和随机在线优化之间进行插值The Stochastically Extended Adversarial (SEA) model provides a unified framework that interpolates between adversarial and stochastic online optimization[16, 69]。在此模型中，随机分量是在每个时间步. In this model, the stochastic component is that at each time steptt，损失函数, the loss functionftf_{t}从分布中得出is drawn from a distribution𝔇t\mathfrak{D}_{t}。这种分布的变化体现了环境的对抗性. The adversarial nature of the environments is captured by shifts in this distribution𝔇t\mathfrak{D}_{t}随着时间的推移。 为了正式描述环境特征，SEA 模型引入了两个关键量：over time. To formally characterize the environments, the SEA model introduces two key quantities:

Σ1:T2\displaystyle\Sigma_{1:T}^{2} =𝔼​[∑t=2Tsup𝐱∈𝒳∥∇Ft​(𝐱)−∇Ft−1​(𝐱)∥22],\displaystyle=\mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t=2}^{T}\sup_{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\lVert\nabla F_{t}(\mathbf{x})-\nabla F_{t-1}(\mathbf{x})\rVert_{2}^{2}\right],
σ1:T2\displaystyle\sigma_{1:T}^{2} =∑t=1Tsup𝐱∈𝒳𝔼​[∥∇ft​(𝐱)−∇Ft​(𝐱)∥22].\displaystyle=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sup_{\mathbf{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\mathbb{E}[\lVert\nabla f_{t}(\mathbf{x})-\nabla F_{t}(\mathbf{x})\rVert_{2}^{2}].

在这里，Here,Ft​(𝐱)=𝔼ft∼𝔇t​[ft​(𝐱)]F_{t}(\mathbf{x})=\mathbb{E}_{f_{t}\sim\mathfrak{D}_{t}}[f_{t}(\mathbf{x})]表示预期损失函数。术语denotes the expected loss function. The termΣ1:T2\Sigma_{1:T}^{2}测量累积分布变化，代表对抗性成分，而measures the cumulative distributional shift, representing the adversarial component, whileσ1:T2\sigma_{1:T}^{2}测量平均值周围的累积随机方差，表示随机分量。 对于凸函数，之前的工作建立了一个静态后悔界限measures the cumulative stochastic variance around the mean, representing the stochastic component. For convex functions, previous work establishes a static regret bound of𝒪​(σ1:T2+Σ1:T2)\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{\sigma_{1:T}^{2}}+\sqrt{\Sigma_{1:T}^{2}}) [16]，以及动态后悔界限, and a dynamic regret bound of𝒪​((σ1:T2+Σ1:T2)​(1+PT)+PT)\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{(\sigma_{1:T}^{2}+\Sigma_{1:T}^{2})(1+P_{T})}+P_{T}) [69].

然而，这些结果分析了全球环境的特性。我们的工作提供了更精致和本地化的视角。具体来说，我们的算法 GAIR-L 的区间动态保证，如定理中所建立的However, these results analyze the environments’ properties globally. Our work offers a more refined and localized perspective. Specifically, the interval dynamic guarantee of our algorithm, GAIR-L, as established in Theorem5，直接暗示了 SEA 模型在任意间隔内的性能的第一个分段特征。这一贡献总结为以下推论。, directly implies the first piecewise characterization of performance under the SEA model over arbitrary intervals. This contribution is summarized in the following corollary.

VII-B SEA 模型在现实世界数据中的应用Application to Real-World Data with SEA Model

为了验证我们的方法的理论保证，特别是新颖的梯度变化界限，我们在 MNIST 数据集上进行了在线多类分类实验。实验设置旨在模拟 SEA 模型（参见第To validate the theoretical guarantees of our methods, particularly the novel gradient-variation bound, we conduct an online multi-class classification experiment on the MNIST dataset. The experimental setup is designed to emulate the SEA model (see SectionVI-B），它为随机和对抗性优化提供了统一的框架。), which provides a unified framework for stochastic and adversarial optimization.

我们通过引入非平稳数据生成过程来模拟 SEA 模型的关键属性。We simulate the key properties of the SEA model by introducing a non-stationary data generation process.

  • •

    分布转变（Distributional Shift (ΣI2\Sigma_{I}^{2}): 模拟底层数据分布的对抗性转变 (): To emulate the adversarial shift of the underlying data distribution (𝔇t\mathfrak{D}_{t}），我们创建一个非平稳的 MNIST 数字流。类分布被设计为随时间变化：一个“主导类”具有明显更高的采样概率，并且该主导类从), we create a non-stationary stream of MNIST digits. The class distribution is designed to change over time: one “dominant class” has a significantly higher sampling probability, and this dominant class cycles sequentially from0通过through99。这种变化的速率由“transition_speed”参数控制，该参数生成分布偏移分量。. The rate of this change is controlled by a “transition_speed” parameter, which generates the distributional shift component.

  • •

    随机行为 (Stochastic Behavior (σI2\sigma_{I}^{2})：环境的随机成分是由数据采样自然产生的。即使主导类别在一段时间内固定，也会在每一步从 MNIST 数据集中随机采样该类别的不同图像。这种随机性引入了损失函数的可变性，从而产生了随机成分。): The stochastic component of the environment arises naturally from the data sampling. Even when the dominant class is fixed for a period, a different image from that class is randomly sampled from the MNIST dataset at each step. This randomness introduces variability in the loss functions, contributing to the stochastic component.

该实验是一个在线多类逻辑回归任务，总共运行了The experiment, an online multi-class logistic regression task, runs for a total ofT=2000T=2000轮次，平均结果超过rounds, with results averaged over55独立运行。我们将算法的性能与前面描述的同一组基线算法进行比较；我们的方法是理论上提供梯度变化后悔界限的唯一方法。根据累积损失来评估性能（图independent runs. We compare the algorithm’s performance against the same set of baseline algorithms described previously; our method is the only one that theoretically provides gradient-variation regret bounds. Performance is evaluated based on both the cumulative loss (Figure4，左）和在线分类准确率（图, Left) and the online classification accuracy (Figure4，对）。, Right).

实证结果证明了所提出的 GAIR-L 算法在非平稳 MNIST 分类任务中的鲁棒性能。如图所示The empirical results demonstrate the robust performance of the proposed GAIR-L algorithm in the non-stationary MNIST classification task. As illustrated in Figure4（右），GAIR-L 快速收敛到最高分类精度，并在整个实验过程中保持这种性能水平。累积损失图如图(Right), GAIR-L rapidly converges to the highest classification accuracy and maintains this level of performance throughout the experiment. The cumulative loss plot in Figure4（左）显示了相应的趋势：虽然GAIR-L在早期阶段没有最低的损失，但随着学习进展到中后期，它实现了最低的累积损失。这种初始较高的损失与其强大的准确性相结合，表明算法的初始适应阶段（​​在此期间校准集合权重）会导致暂时较高的损失，但最终会带来更好的长期性能。这种行为与我们在非平稳环境中获得强大的预测准确性的设计目标是一致的。(Left) shows a corresponding trend: while GAIR-L does not have the lowest loss in the early phase, it achieves the lowest cumulative loss as learning progresses into the middle and later stages. This initial higher loss, paired with its strong accuracy, suggests that the algorithm’s initial adaptation phase, during which it calibrates the ensemble weights, leads to temporarily higher loss but ultimately better long-term performance. This behavior is consistent with our design goal of attaining strong predictive accuracy in non-stationary environments.

八VIII结论Conclusions

在本文中，我们开发了一种用于区间遗憾最小化的多功能在线算法，名为 GAIR-L（算法In this paper, we develop a versatile online algorithm for interval regret minimization, named GAIR-L (Algorithm3）。除了处理非平稳性之外，我们的方法还有两个关键优势：它需要最少的参数调整，并且通过梯度变化量和算法设计统一了几个重要的结果。对于未来的工作，一个有希望的方向是开发更全面地依赖于梯度变化的遗憾界限。另一个是探索我们的结果扩展到游戏优化的设置。). Beyond handling non-stationarity, our method has two key advantages: it requires minimal parameter tuning, and it unifies several important results through the gradient variation quantity and algorithmic designs. For future work, one promising direction is to develop regret bounds that depend more comprehensively on gradient variation. Another is to explore the extension of our results to the setting of game optimization.

附录BAppendix B元算法的部分证明Proof of Meta Algorithm in SectionV

在本节中，我们为所提出的 Lipschitz 自适应元算法建立理论保证。除了适应性后悔结果之外，这些保证可能具有独立的利益。为了进一步增强该定理的实用性和通用性，我们在睡眠专家范式下证明了保证。In this section, we establish theoretical guarantees for the proposed Lipschitz-adaptive meta-algorithm. Beyond the adaptive-regret results, these guarantees may be of independent interest. To further enhance the theorem’s practicality and generality, we prove guarantees under the sleeping-expert paradigm.
